verdict.rationale: treg documents transparent per-call pricing. Calls are metered from a prepaid balance at the provider's own rate with no markup, every catalogued endpoint carries its price, platforms can be compared side by side on price, and per-success misses settle at $0.00. The evidence pack contains no documentation of treg's own rate limits or quotas, so only half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented rate limits/quotas per tool or plan, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform

citations.quote: A prepaid balance, metered per call at the provider's own rate, with no markup. The first $1.00 is free.
Every catalogued endpoint carries its price, parameters and an example response.
`/catalog/platforms/{slug}` lists them side by side with measured success rate, speed and price.
On per-success tools, a miss settles at $0.00.
